title: Chip-label option and nav subtitles come from the projection
description:
What: projection options for hiding or relabelling concept chips and for nav item subtitles, so MoM can delete _unlabel_concept_chips and its nav subtitle code.
Acceptance:
Scenario: A site sets chip labels off in projection.json
  Given the option is off
  When a card renders
  Then no label HTML is emitted and nothing is stripped afterwards
